name: spa-vite-react
author: Marlon Chaviano
title: SPA with Vite and React
description: React + TypeScript with Vite and Tailwind CSS: instant startup and fast builds, no server. For dashboards, internal tools and API frontends.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Components in `src/components/`, one per file; import with the `@/` alias (`@/components/...`).
- Style with Tailwind CSS v4 classes (`src/index.css` imports Tailwind).
- It's an SPA: data comes from an API; public variables are prefixed with `VITE_`.
- Before finishing: `npm run build` (includes type checking).
